'''Randy Bautista''' is a Star Wars CCG player whose decks were published on [[Trandosite]], [[Rod Latham]]'s UK fan site.<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls61.htm Mind What Leia Has Learned], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228060027/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls61.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

* [[Randy Bautista Mind What Leia Has Learned|Mind What Leia Has Learned]] (Light)
* [[Randy Bautista Revenge of the Jawas|Revenge of the Jawas]] (Dark)
